column1: # Consumer/Thor Blackwell vs datacenter Blackwell -- per-op issue-relative stall deltas.
# Our own differential-analysis result (NOT a binary byte table): identical PTX compiled
# with this exact ptxas (CUDA 13.0.88) and disassembled (nvdisasm 13.1), reading the
# usched stall field of each emitted instruction.  All five arches share the lat10x
# latency-descriptor family and resolve to the sm_103 dependency-rule + scoreboard tables
# (installer sub_ABF590 enum 0x4001); these are the residual per-arch scheduler deltas the
# OCG applies on top of that shared base, observed on a mixed decoupled-op probe kernel.
# Coupled-math ops (FADD/FFMA/FMUL/IMAD/IADD3/SHF/LDG/STG) are IDENTICAL across all five
# arches (shared lat10x descriptors) and are omitted.  Only the decoupled bands differ.
# sm_120 == sm_121 byte-identical (verified).  "base" = the sm_103 value all arches share
# unless noted.  Stall = cycles the dependent consumer is held (usched stall enum).
